Name: ATM
Author: Platonymous
Description:
Adds an ATM to the Town.

By default the ATM shows up to the left of the hospital.
Position and map can be changed in the config file.

It can be used to deposit and withdraw money from your bankaccount, or setup a money order for daily deposits. Your credit line adjusts [s]every year[/s] month (or as specified in the config file). Every first of each season you pay interest on loans as well as receive interest for deposited money. Interests will be added or taken from your account. If you don't have enough money or credit it will be taken from your wallet or kept for next seasons payment. Credit & interest can be adjusted or deactivated in the config file.

In multiplayer only the host can access the ATM.

Thanks to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/users/61584511]xlx93330[/url] for the chinese translation.
